criteria.description: version command reports version, commit, and build date on one line
criteria.evidence: TestVersionCommandOutput asserts `spec-kitty-analyzer dev (commit none, built unknown)`; injected form verified behaviorally.

criteria.description: analyze/query/missions JSON expose a nested `build` object
criteria.evidence: Nested `build` object asserted for Report/query.Result/missions; end-to-end `missions` JSON shows build{version,commit,build_date}.

criteria.description: tagged release build reports tag-derived version + commit + date
criteria.evidence: Simulated tag build via `-ldflags -X` (lowercase path) reports 0.3.0/commit/date; WP02 injects on both build lines, tag-gated (C-006).
TestCurrentBuildDefaults + `version` dev output = dev/none/unknown; WP02 leaves sentinels on non-tag runs.

criteria.description: top-level `version` field removed from all JSON output
criteria.evidence: All three emitter tests assert ABSENCE of top-level `version`; end-to-end `missions` JSON has no top-level version.

criteria.description: published release documents the JSON schema change as breaking
criteria.evidence: docs/releases/release-notes-0.3.0.md documents the `.version`->`.build.version` break (Codex-reviewed); published via `--notes-file`.
